value.name: elena returns to quarters
value.description: Elena comes back to the lighthouse keeper's quarters and finds Marcus seated at the kitchen table with papers spread out.
evidence: Elena returns to find Marcus at the kitchen table, papers spread before him.

value.name: marcus calms barking dog
value.description: Marcus calls out through the door to calm the barking dog, and the barking stops.
evidence:
MARCUS
(calling through the door)
Captain! Easy!

value.name: marcus explains dog's behavior
value.description: Marcus tells Elena that the dog gets agitated when the pressure drops, revealing his familiarity with the animal and conditions.
evidence:
MARCUS (CONT'D)
He gets wound up when the pressure drops.

value.name: elena questions marcus's leg
value.description: Elena asks Marcus whether his leg problem comes from an old injury.
evidence:
ELENA
Your leg. Is it an old injury?

value.name: marcus recounts trawler injury
value.description: Marcus explains that he injured his left leg on a fishing trawler in 1991 when a cable snapped and says he was lucky to keep it.
evidence:
MARCUS
Left leg. Fishing trawler, 1991. A cable snapped. Lucky I kept it.

value.name: elena reports suspicious vehicle
value.description: Elena says she returned by a different route and noticed a vehicle near the outbuilding when she arrived.
evidence:
ELENA
I came back a different route this evening. There was a vehicle near the outbuilding when I pulled in.

value.name: marcus identifies borrowed vehicle
value.description: Marcus claims the vehicle belongs to Tom Briggs and says he borrowed it because his own vehicle is being serviced.
evidence:
MARCUS
That's Tom Briggs's. Borrowed it -- my own vehicle is in for service.

value.name: elena tests marcus's account
value.description: Elena asks Marcus whether he saw her arrive in the blue vehicle, probing the consistency of his explanation.
evidence:
ELENA
So you saw me drive in with the blue one?

value.name: marcus confirms only arrival
value.description: Marcus says he saw Elena drive in and asserts that hers was the only vehicle to come up the road all evening.
evidence:
MARCUS
(nodding)
Hard to miss on this road. Only vehicle that came up all evening.

value.name: elena records suspicious note
value.description: Elena writes something in her notebook and underlines it twice, signaling that Marcus's statement is important to her.
evidence: Elena opens her notebook and writes something she underlines twice.
